abstract: The value of whole lung tomography was compared to chest x-rays in patients with renal cell carcinoma and germ cell testicular tumors. We studied 83 patients with testicular tumors and 34 with renal cell carcinoma. At least 1 metastatic lesion was present on whole lung tomography in 11 of 64 patients (17 per cent) with testicular tumors and 2 of 21 (10 per cent) with renal cell carcinoma who had negative chest x-rays. Of the patients with a solitary lesion on the chest x-ray 3 of 10 (30 per cent) with testicular tumor and 5 of 11 (45 per cent) with renal cell carcinoma had multiple metastatic lesions on whole lung tomograms. Falsely positive chest x-rays were noted in 6 of 15 patients (40 per cent) with renal cell carcinoma and 6 of 16 (37 per cent) with testis tumor. These falsely positive results were caused by overlapping shadows, vessels or granulomas.
abstract_ja: 腎細胞癌および胚細胞性精巣腫瘍の患者において、転移性病変の早期発見における全肺断層撮影の有用性を胸部X線と比較した。精巣腫瘍患者83例および腎細胞癌患者34例を検討した。胸部X線が陰性であった精巣腫瘍患者64例中11例（17%）、腎細胞癌患者21例中2例（10%）で、断層撮影により少なくとも1つの転移(性)病変が認められた。胸部X線で単発病変が認められた症例のうち、精巣腫瘍では10例中3例（30%）、腎細胞癌では11例中5例（45%）で、断層撮影により多発転移が認められた。胸部X線の偽陽性は、腎細胞癌患者15例中6例（40%）、精巣腫瘍患者16例中6例（37%）で認められた。これらの偽陽性所見は、重なり影、血管、または肉芽腫によるものであった。
